caption:
🥪 CHEESE GRILLED SANDWICH
That crispy, golden street-style sandwich with a spicy green chutney and a proper cheesy onion-capsicum stuffing 🤤🧀
Makes: 4 sandwiches

GREEN CHUTNEY 🌿
½ cup coriander
¼ cup mint
2–3 garlic cloves
2 green chillies
½ tsp cumin powder
½ tsp chaat masala
2–3 ice cubes
Salt, to taste
1–2 tbsp cold water, as required
Blend everything until smooth and keep it thick and spreadable.

CHEESY VEGETABLE STUFFING 🧀
1 medium capsicum, finely chopped
1 medium onion, finely chopped
2 green chillies, finely chopped
3 tbsp fresh coriander, finely chopped
200g grated cheese
½ tsp cumin powder
¼ tsp black pepper powder
½ tsp chaat masala
½ tsp chilli flakes
¼ tsp salt
Add the onion, capsicum, green chillies and coriander to a bowl. Add all the spices and salt and mix well.
Add 200g grated cheese and mix until the cheese is evenly distributed throughout the vegetables.

TO MAKE THE SANDWICH 🥪
8 bread slices
Butter, as required
Prepared green chutney
Prepared cheesy vegetable stuffing
1. Take 2 bread slices and spread butter on one side of each.
2. Spread a generous layer of green chutney over the butter.
3. Add a portion of the cheesy vegetable stuffing to one slice and spread evenly.
4. Cover with the second bread slice.
5. Butter the outer sides of the sandwich.
6. Place in a gas sandwich maker and grill until golden brown, crisp and the cheese is melted.
7. Trim off any excess filling that spills out.
8. Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 4 sandwiches.
Serve hot with extra green chutney and watch that cheese pull 🧀🤌🏼

PRO TIP: Grate the cheese finely so it melts quickly and binds beautifully with the onion and capsicum while grilling.
